title: TreeResolve repository config
description: Schema for .treeresolverc, .treeresolverc.json, or treeresolve.json at a repository root. Matches fields honored by RepoConfigService.

autoMergeImports.description: Default auto-merge policy for deterministic import / syntax merges when no glob rule matches.

autoMergeLockfiles.description: Hint for lockfile auto-merge preference (subject to Pro entitlement and resolver coverage).

autoMergeYaml.description: Hint for YAML auto-merge preference (subject to Pro entitlement).

stageOnSave.description: Default whether to git-add after a fully resolved save when no glob rule matches.

rules.description: Ordered glob rules; first match wins for the target file path.

pattern.description: Glob matched against the document path (forward-slash normalized).
